newsitem.title: USA: Washington Gov. signs $1.9 bln capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Washington Gov. signs $1.9 bln capital budget.

text.p: Washington Gov. Gary Locke signed into law a $1.9 billion capital construction plan to fund projects across the state, his office said Monday.
The construction budget signed by Locke would support a variety of new projects, from school buildings to a new 1,936-bed prison in Grays Harbor County, state officials said.

The state's Democratic governor has yet to act on the legislature's $19.07 billion state budget proposal and its $3 billion transportation spending plan. Both were passed by the legislature over the weekend.
Locke has 20 days to review the spending plans and more than 250 other bills.
